description: This file contains the implementation of the GuzzleHttp Client class, which provides methods for making HTTP requests asynchronously and synchronously, handling request options, and managing client configuration.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: The Client class implements an HTTP client that allows sending requests asynchronously and synchronously. It manages default configurations, handles request options, and integrates middleware handling through handler stacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Client instance, initializing configuration options, handling base_uri, and setting default request parameters.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle dynamic request method calls (e.g., getAsync, post). Deprecated in favor of explicit methods.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously, merging request options with default configurations.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously by waiting on the promise returned by sendAsync.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Implementation of the PSR-18 sendRequest method, wrapping sendAsync with predefined options to disable redirects and errors.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options, building the request object accordingly.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP request by waiting on the promise from requestAsync.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the client configuration options, either all or a specific one.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Builds a complete URI by resolving base_uri and handling IDN conversion if configured.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets up default configuration options for the client, including proxy settings, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges default options into the request-specific options, handling headers and conditional request parameters.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Performs the actual transfer of the request using the handler stack, returning a promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Applies various request options (headers, body, auth, query, etc.) to the request object.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Returns an InvalidArgumentException if the request body is improperly set as an array.
